svg.title: How I got here. 2020: I looked after the computers at my father's business, for a staff of ten. I was the whole IT department. 2025: First place at the AUS High School Computing Competition with Digital EcoHome, a smart-home app that read eleven Arduino sensors. 2025: Finished school at the top of my class, and started Data Science and AI at UAEU. 2026: Two browser games for Hack Club Terra, a price model from 109,706 Dubai property sales, then nine builds in seventeen days for one TinyFish bounty round.
